claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II mission had a crew of four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission lasted 10 days.
The Artemis II mission went around the moon.
The Artemis II crew was recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II crew is safe.
The Artemis II crew is returning to Houston for post-mission evaluations.
The Artemis II 10-day flight tested systems to prepare for future human moon landings.
